rationale: Luke's work on AI-powered adaptive learning and generative video at Infinity AI Institute intersects directly with Lauren's conviction that 'AI meeting biology at scale' and her deep venture expertise in biotech innovation. intro_message: Luke Bechtel, meet Lauren Dermody — you both work at the intersection of AI and emerging domains (generative video and biotech), and Lauren's venture investing perspective could offer valuable context for your thinking on scalable AI tools.
